verses.geez: አንተሰ፡ ጥበበ፡ ስብከ፡ ከመ፡ አእምሮ፡ ታውሥእከ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt proclaim wisdom, that understanding may be obedient to thee.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt proclaim wisdom, that understanding may be obedient to thee.
translations.kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
translations.ron: Oare înţelepciunea nu strigă ea şi priceperea nu-şi ridică glasul său?
translations.grk: Σὺ τὴν σοφίαν κηρύξεις, ἵνα φρόνησίς σοι ὑπακούσῃ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽንፈ፡ ነዋኃት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ፍናው፡ ቆመት፡ ወውስተ፡ አናቅጾሙ፡ ለኃያላን፡ ትጸንሕ።
verses.translation: For she is on lofty eminences, and stands in the midst of the ways.

translations.lxx: For she is on lofty eminences, and stands in the midst of the ways.
translations.kjv: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
translations.ron: Pe vârfurile cele mai înalte, pe cale, la răspântiile drumurilor stă,
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ γὰρ τῶν ὑψηλῶν ἄκρων ἐστὶν, ἀναμέσον δὲ τῶν τρίβων ἕστηκε.

verses.geez: ወበውስተ፡ ፍነው፡ ትሴባሕ፡ ኪያክሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ አስተበቊዕ፡ ወእነግር፡ ቃለ፡ ዚኣየ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: For she sits by the gates of princes, and sings in the entrances, saying,

translations.lxx: For she sits by the gates of princes, and sings in the entrances, saying,
translations.kjv: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
translations.ron: Pe lângă porţi, în împrejurimile cetăţii, la intrarea porţilor, strigă tare:
translations.grk: Παρὰ γὰρ πύλαις δυναστῶν παρεδρεύει, ἐν δὲ εἰσόδοις ὑμνεῖται.

verses.geez: አእምሩ፡ የዋሃን፡ ተጠብቦ፡ ወዓብዳን፡ አጥርዩ፡ ልበ።
verses.translation: You, O men, I exhort; and utter my voice to the sons of men.

translations.lxx: You, O men, I exhort; and utter my voice to the sons of men.
translations.kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
translations.ron: "Către voi, oamenilor, se îndreaptă strigătul meu şi glasul meu către voi, fii ai oamenilor.
translations.grk: Ὑμᾶς ὦ ἄνθρωποι παρακαλῶ, καὶ προΐεμαι ἐμὴν φωνὴν υἱοῖς ἀνθρώπων.

verses.geez: ስምዑኒ፡ እስመ፡ መፍትወ፡ አየድዕ፡ ወአወፅእ፡ እምከናፍርየ፡ ርቱዐ።
verses.translation: O ye simple, understand subtlety, and ye that are untaught, imbibe knowledge.

translations.lxx: O ye simple, understand subtlety, and ye that are untaught, imbibe knowledge.
translations.kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
translations.ron: Voi, cei simpli, învăţaţi cuminţenia şi voi, cei nebuni, înţelepţiţi-vă!
translations.grk: Νοήσατε ἄκακοι πανουργίαν, οἱ δὲ ἀπαίδευτοι ἔνθεσθε καρδίαν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ትሜህር፡ ጒርዔየ፡ ወርኩሳት፡ በቅድሜየ፡ ከናፍረ፡ ሐሰት።
verses.translation: Hearken to me; for I will speak solemn truths; and will produce right sayings from my lips.

translations.lxx: Hearken to me; for I will speak solemn truths; and will produce right sayings from my lips.
translations.kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi, căci voi spune lucruri măreţe şi buzele mele se deschid pentru a înălţa ceea ce este drept;
translations.grk: Εἰσακούσατέ μου, σεμνὰ γὰρ ἐρῶ, καὶ ἀνοίσω ἀπὸ χειλέων ὀρθά.

verses.geez: ወጽድቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቃለ፡ አፉየ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ጠዋይ፡ ወማዕቅፍ።
verses.translation: For my throat shall meditate truth; and false lips are an abomination before me.

translations.lxx: For my throat shall meditate truth; and false lips are an abomination before me.
translations.kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
translations.ron: Căci gura mea grăieşte adevărul şi buzele mele se dezgustă de fărădelege.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἀλήθειαν μελετήσει ὁ φάρυγξ μου, ἐβδελυγμένα δὲ ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ χείλη ψευδῆ.

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ርቱዕ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለእለ፡ የአምሩ፡ ወርቱዕ፡ ለእለ፡ ይረክቡ፡ ልቡና።
verses.translation: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing in them wrong or perverse.

translations.lxx: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing in them wrong or perverse.
translations.kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
translations.ron: Toate graiurile gurii mele sunt întru dreptate, în ele nu este nimic sucit şi fără rost;
translations.grk: Μετὰ δικαιοσύνης πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου, οὐδὲν ἐαυτοῖς σκολιὸν οὐδὲ στραγγαλιῶδες.

verses.geez: ንሥኡ፡ ትምህርተ፡ እምብሩር፡ ወአእምሮ፡ እምቀርቅ፡ ፍቱን፡ ወተወከፉ፡ ተዓውቆ፡ እምወርቅ፡ ጽሩይ።
verses.translation: They are all evident to those that understand, and right to those that find knowledge.

translations.lxx: They are all evident to those that understand, and right to those that find knowledge.
translations.kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
translations.ron: Toate sunt lămurite pentru cel priceput şi drepte pentru cei ce au aflat ştiinţa.
translations.grk: Πάντα ἐνώπια τοῖς συνιοῦσι, καὶ ὀρθὰ τοῖς εὑρίσκουσι γνῶσιν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ትኄይስ፡ ጥበብ፡ እምዕንቊ፡ ዘብዙኅ፡ ሤጡ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ክብር፡ ኢመጠና፡ ላቲ።
verses.translation: Receive instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than tried gold.

translations.lxx: Receive instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than tried gold.
translations.kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
translations.ron: Luaţi învăţătura mea mai degrabă decât argintul şi ştiinţa mai mult decât aurul cel mai curat,
translations.grk: Λάβετε παιδείαν καὶ μὴ ἀργύριον, καὶ γνῶσιν ὑπὲρ χρυσίον δεδοκιμασμένον·

verses.geez: አነ፡ ጥበብ፡ አኅደርኩ፡ ምክረ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ወሕሊና፡ አነ፡ ጸዋዕኩ።
verses.translation: For wisdom is better than precious stones; and no valuable substance is of equal worth with it.

translations.lxx: For wisdom is better than precious stones; and no valuable substance is of equal worth with it.
translations.kjv: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
translations.ron: Căci înţelepciunea este mai bună decât pietrele preţioase şi nici lucrurile cele mai preţioase nu au valoarea ei.
translations.grk: Κρείσσων γὰρ σοφία λίθων πολυτελῶν, πᾶν δὲ τίμιον οὐκ ἄξιον αὐτῆς ἐστιν.

verses.geez: ፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይጸልእ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ጽልአ፡ ወትዕቢተ፡ ወፍናወ፡ እኩያተ፡ ጸላእኩ።
verses.translation: I wisdom have dwelt with counsel and knowledge, and I have called upon understanding.

translations.lxx: I wisdom have dwelt with counsel and knowledge, and I have called upon understanding.
translations.kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
translations.ron: Eu, înţelepciunea, locuiesc împreună cu prevederea şi stăpânesc ştiinţa şi buna-chibzuială.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ ἡ σοφία κατεσκήνωσα βουλὴν καὶ γνῶσιν, καὶ ἔννοιαν ἐγὼ ἐπεκαλεσάμην.

verses.geez: ወዓዲ፡ ጸላእኩ፡ ጠዋያተ፡ ፍናወ፡ እኩያን፡ ሊተ፡ ምክር፡ ወእዘዝ፡ ሊተ፡ አእምሮ፡ ወሊተ፡ ጽንዕ።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord hates unrighteousness, and insolence, and pride, and the ways of wicked men; and I hate the perverse ways of bad men.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord hates unrighteousness, and insolence, and pride, and the ways of wicked men; and I hate the perverse ways of bad men.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
translations.ron: Frica de Dumnezeu este urgisirea răului. Mândria şi obrăznicia, calea răutăţii şi gura cea aprigă le urăsc eu.
translations.grk: Φόβος Κυρίου μισεῖ ἀδικίαν, ὕβριν τε καὶ ὑπερηφανίαν καὶ ὁδοὺς πονηρῶν· μεμίσηκα δὲ ἐγὼ διεστραμμένας ὁδοὺς κακῶν.

verses.geez: ብየ፡ ነገሥት፡ ይነግሡ፡ ወኃያላን፡ ይጽሕፉ፡ ጽድቀ።
verses.translation: Counsel and safety are mine: prudence is mine, and strength is mine.

translations.lxx: Counsel and safety are mine: prudence is mine, and strength is mine.
translations.kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
translations.ron: Al meu este sfatul şi buna-chibzuială, eu sunt priceperea, a mea este puterea.
translations.grk: Ἐμὴ βουλὴ καὶ ἀσφάλεια, ἐμὴ φρόνησις, ἐμὴ δὲ ἰσχύς.

verses.geez: ብየ፡ ዓቢያን፡ ይከብሩ፡ ወመኳንንት፡ ይእኅዙ፡ ምድረ።
verses.translation: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

translations.lxx: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
translations.kjv: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
translations.ron: Prin mine împărăţesc împăraţii şi principii rânduiesc dreptatea.
translations.grk: Διʼ ἐμοῦ βασιλεῖς βασιλεύουσι, καὶ οἱ δυνάσται γράφουσιν δικαιοσύνην.

verses.geez: አነ፡ እለ፡ ያፈቅሩኒ፡ አፈቅር፡ ወእለ፡ የኀሥሡ፡ ኪያየ፡ ይረክቡ፡ ሞገሰ።
verses.translation: By me nobles become great, and monarchs by me rule over the earth.

translations.lxx: By me nobles become great, and monarchs by me rule over the earth.
translations.kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
translations.ron: Prin mine cârmuiesc dregătorii şi mai-marii sunt judecătorii pământului.
translations.grk: Διʼ ἐμοῦ μεγιστᾶνες μεγαλύνονται, καὶ τύραννοι διʼ ἐμοῦ κρατοῦσι γῆς.

verses.geez: ክብር፡ ወብዕል፡ ኀቤየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ወጥሪት፡ ብዙኅ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ይኄይስ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ኀሪይ፡ እምወርቅ፡ ወእምዕንቊ፡ ክቡር።
verses.translation: I love those that love me; and they that seek me shall find me.

translations.lxx: I love those that love me; and they that seek me shall find me.
translations.kjv: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
translations.ron: Eu iubesc pe cei ce mă iubesc şi cei ce mă caută mă găsesc.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ τοὺς ἐμὲ φιλοῦντας ἀγαπῶ, οἱ δὲ ἐμὲ ζητοῦντες εὑρήσουσιν.

verses.geez: ወፍሬ፡ ዚአየ፡ ይኄይስ፡ እምብሩር፡ ጽሩይ።
verses.translation: Wealth and glory belong to me; yea, abundant possessions and righteousness.

translations.lxx: Wealth and glory belong to me; yea, abundant possessions and righteousness.
translations.kjv: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
translations.ron: Cu mine este bogăţia şi mărirea, averea vrednică de cinste şi dreptatea.
translations.grk: Πλοῦτος καὶ δόξα ἐμοὶ ὑπάρχει, καὶ κτῆσις πολλῶν καὶ δικαιοσύνη.

verses.geez: ወውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ ጽድቅ፡ አንሶሱ፡ ወማእከለ፡ አሠረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ እትመያየጥ።
verses.translation: It is better to have my fruit than to have gold and precious stones; and my produce is better than choice silver.

translations.lxx: It is better to have my fruit than to have gold and precious stones; and my produce is better than choice silver.
translations.kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
translations.ron: Rodul meu e mai bun decât aurul şi decât aurul cel mai curat, şi ceea ce vine de la mine este mai de preţ decât argintul lămurit.
translations.grk: Βέλτιον ἐμὲ καρπίζεσθαι ὑπὲρ χρυσίον καὶ λίθον τίμιον, τὰ δὲ ἐμὰ γεννήματα κρείσσω ἀργυρίου ἐκλεκτοῦ.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ እከፍሎሙ፡ ጥሪተ፡ ለእለ፡ የአምሩኒ፡ ወመዛግብቲሆሙ፡ እምላእ፡ ተድላ።
verses.translation: I walk in ways of righteousness, and am conversant with the paths of judgment;

translations.lxx: I walk in ways of righteousness, and am conversant with the paths of judgment;
translations.kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
translations.ron: Merg pe calea dreptăţii, în mijlocul căilor judecăţii drepte,
translations.grk: Ἐν ὁδοῖς δικαιοσύνης περιπατῶ, καὶ ἀναμέσον τρίβων δικαιώματος ἀναστρέφομαι·

verses.geez: እመ፡ ነገርኩክሙ፡ እንተ፡ ጸብሐት፡ ዘይከውን፡ ወዓዲ፡ እዜከር፡ ዘእምዓለም፡ ኊልቈ።
verses.translation: that I may divide substance to them that love me, and may fill their treasures with good things.

translations.lxx: If I declare to you the things that daily happen, I will remember also to recount the things of old.
translations.kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
translations.ron: Ca să dau celor ce mă iubesc bogăţii şi să le umplu cămările lor.
translations.grk: ἵνα μερίσω τοῖς ἐμὲ ἀγαπῶσιν ὕπαρξιν, καὶ τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν ἐμπλήσω ἀγαθῶν· ἐὰν ἀναγγείλω ὑμῖν τὰ καθʼ ἡμέραν γινόμενα, μνημονεύσω τὰ ἐξ αἰῶνος ἀριθμῆσαι.

verses.geez: እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈጠረኒ፡ ቀዳሜ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተግባሩ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ይሣርር፡ ዓለመ።
verses.translation: The Lord made me the beginning of his ways for his works.

translations.lxx: The Lord made me the beginning of his ways for his works.
translations.kjv: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
translations.ron: Domnul m-a zidit la începutul lucrărilor Lui; înainte de lucrările Lui cele mai de demult.
translations.grk: Κύριος ἔκτισέ με ἀρχὴν ὁδῶν αὐτοῦ εἰς ἔργα αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወዘእንበለ፡ ይግበር፡ ምድረ፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ይግበር፡ ቀላያተ፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ይፃኡ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማያት።
verses.translation: He established me before time was in the beginning, before he made the earth:

translations.lxx: He established me before time was in the beginning, before he made the earth:
translations.kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
translations.ron: Eu am fost din veac întemeiată de la început, înainte de a se fi făcut pământul.
translations.grk: πρὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐθεμελίωσέ με, ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸ τοῦ τὴν γῆν ποιῆσαι,

verses.geez: ወዘእንበለ፡ አድባር፡ ይተከሉ፡ (ይጠዓጥዑ)፡ ወእምቅድመ፡ አውግር፡ ወለደኒ።
verses.translation: even before he made the depths; before the fountains of water came forth:

translations.lxx: even before he made the depths; before the fountains of water came forth:
translations.kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
translations.ron: Nu era adâncul atunci când am fost născută, nici chiar izvoare încărcate cu apă.
translations.grk: καὶ πρὸ τοῦ τὰς ἀβύσσους ποιῆσαι, πρὸ τοῦ προελθεῖν τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων·

verses.geez: ወእምቅድመ፡ ይግበር፡ በሐውርተ፡ ወአጽናፈ፡ ዘይትኅደር፡ እምሰማይ።
verses.translation: before the mountains were settled, and before all hills, he begets me.

translations.lxx: before the mountains were settled, and before all hills, he begets me.
translations.kjv: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
translations.ron: Înainte de a fi fost întemeiaţi munţii şi înaintea văilor eu am luat fiinţă.
translations.grk: Πρὸ τοῦ ὄρη ἑδρασθῆναι, πρὸ δὲ πάντων βουνῶν, γεννᾷ με.

verses.geez: አመ፡ ያስተዴሉ፡ ሰማያተ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ወአመ፡ ያጸንዕ፡ መንበረ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፋሳት።
verses.translation: The Lord made countries and uninhabited tracts, and the highest inhabited parts of the world.

translations.lxx: The Lord made countries and uninhabited tracts, and the highest inhabited parts of the world.
translations.kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
translations.ron: Când încă nu era făcut pământul, nici câmpiile, nici cel dintâi fir de praf din lume,
translations.grk: Κύριος ἐποίησε χώρας καὶ ἀοικήτους, καὶ ἄκρα οἰκούμενα τῆς ὑπʼ οὐρανῶν.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ይገብር፡ በመልዕልተ፡ ደመናት፡ ወአመ፡ ያፀንዕ፡ አንብሮ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማያት።
verses.translation: When he prepared the heaven, I was present with him; and when he prepared his throne upon the winds:

translations.lxx: When he prepared the heaven, I was present with him; and when he prepared his throne upon the winds:
translations.kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
translations.ron: Când El a întemeiat cerurile eu eram acolo; când El a tras bolta cerului peste faţa adâncului,
translations.grk: Ἡνίκα ἡτοίμαζε τὸν οὐρανὸν, συμπαρήμην αὐτῷ, καὶ ὅτε ἀφώριζε τὸν ἑαυτοῦ θρόνον ἐπʼ ἀνέμων,

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ያነብር፡ ወሰነ፡ ለባሕር፡ ወማያት፡ ኢይፃኡ፡ እምአፈ፡ ዚአሁ።
verses.translation: and when he strengthened the clouds above; and when he secured the fountains of the earth:

translations.lxx: and when he strengthened the clouds above; and when he secured the fountains of the earth:
translations.kjv: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
translations.ron: Când a întărit norii sus şi izvoarele adâncului curgeau din belşug,
translations.grk: καὶ ὡς ἰσχυρὰ ἐποίει τὰ ἄνω νέφη, καὶ ὡς ἀσφαλεῖς ἐτίθει πηγὰς τῆς ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν,

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ይገብር፡ ወሠረታተ፡ ምድር፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ እንዘ፡ አስተዋድድ።
verses.translation: and when he strengthened the foundations of the earth:

translations.lxx: and when he strengthened the foundations of the earth:
translations.kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
translations.ron: Când El a pus hotar mării, ca apele să nu mai treacă peste ţărmuri şi când El a aşezat temeliile pământului,
translations.grk: καὶ ὡς ἰσχυρὰ ἐποίει τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς,

verses.geez: አነ፡ ይእቲ፡ እንተ፡ እትፌሣሕ፡ እንተ፡ ጽብሐት፡ ወእትኃሠይ፡ በበገጹ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወአመ፡ ይትፌሣሕ፡ ዓለመ፡ ፈጺሞ፡ ወፍሥሓየኒ፡ በደቂቀ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው።
verses.translation: I was by him, suiting myself to him, I was that wherein he took delight; and daily I rejoiced in his presence continually.

translations.lxx: I was by him, suiting myself to him, I was that wherein he took delight; and daily I rejoiced in his presence continually.
translations.kjv: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
translations.ron: Atunci eu eram ca un copil mic alături de El, veselindu-mă în fiecare zi şi desfătându-mă fără încetare în faţa Lui;
translations.grk: ἤμην παρʼ αὐτῷ ἁρμόζουσα· ἐγὼ ἤμην ᾗ προσέχαιρε· καθʼ ἡμέραν δὲ εὐφραινόμην ἐν προσώπῳ αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ,

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ወልድየ፡ ስምዓኒ፡ ብፁዓን፡ እለ፡ የዓቅቡ፡ ፍኖትየ።
verses.translation: For he rejoiced when he had completed the world, and rejoiced among the children of men.

translations.lxx: For he rejoiced when he had completed the world, and rejoiced among the children of men.
translations.kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
translations.ron: Dezmierdându-mă pe rotundul pământului Lui şi găsindu-mi plăcerea printre fiii oamenilor.
translations.grk: ὅτε ἐνευφραίνετο τὴν οἰκουμένην συντελέσας, καὶ ἐνευφραίνετο ἐν υἱοῖς ἀνθρώπων.

verses.geez: ስምዑ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወጥበቡ፡ ወኢትትፈፀሙ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይሰምዓኒ፡ ቃልየ።
verses.translation: Now then, my son, hear me: blessed is the man who shall hearken to me, and the mortal who shall keep my ways;

translations.lxx: Now then, my son, hear me: blessed is the man who shall hearken to me, and the mortal who shall keep my ways;
translations.kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
translations.ron: Şi acum, fiilor, ascultaţi-mă! Fericiţi sunt cei ce păzesc căile mele!
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν υἱὲ ἄκουέ μου,

verses.geez: ወብፁዕ፡ ዘየዓቅብ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ ወይተግህ፡ ውስተ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ዚአየ፡ እንተ፡ ጸብሐት፡ ወዘየዓቅብ፡ ራግዛተ፡ ሙባእየ።

translations.kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi învăţătura, ca să ajungeţi înţelepţi, şi nu o lepădaţi.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ፍናውየ፡ ፍናወ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘረከበኒ፡ ረከበ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ወይዴላው፡ ፈቃዱ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my entrances.

translations.lxx: watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my entrances.
translations.kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
translations.ron: Fericit este omul care ascultă de mine şi veghează în fiecare zi la porţile mele şi cel ce străjuieşte lângă pragul casei mele!
translations.grk: μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὃς εἰσακούσεταί μου, καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς τὰς ἐμὰς ὁδοὺς φυλάξει, ἀγρυπνῶν ἐπʼ ἐμαῖς θύραις καθʼ ἡμέραν, τηρῶν σταθμοὺς ἐμῶν εἰσόδων.

verses.geez: ወእለሰ፡ ይኤብሱ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ይጌግዩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ወእለ፡ ይጸልኡኒ፡ ያፈቅሩ፡ ሞተ።
verses.translation: For my outgoings are the outgoings of life, and in them is prepared favour from the Lord.

translations.lxx: For my outgoings are the outgoings of life, and in them is prepared favour from the Lord.
translations.kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
translations.ron: Cel ce mă află, a aflat viaţa şi dobândeşte har de la Domnul;
translations.grk: Αἱ γὰρ ἔξοδοί μου, ἔξοδοι ζωῆς, καὶ ἑτοιμάζεται θέλησις παρὰ Κυρίου.

note: Wisdom speaks: 'The Lord created me at the beginning of his work.' Personified Wisdom as co-creator. This passage, alongside Sirach 24 and Wisdom 7, forms the Jewish wisdom Christology that shaped the Gospel of John's Logos theology.
